summary: Tested current story `bootstrap-nextjs-app` for module `feedback`, iteration 2. Full Playwright execution did not pass: `npm run test:e2e` started the single Chromium test but failed with `Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while setting up "page"`, producing `test-results/feedback-bootstrap-nextjs--b9cd4-without-starter-boilerplate-chromium/error-context.md` and `trace.zip`. Because the current story browser test does not pass, success cannot be claimed.
